dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to book a therapy session.

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: Really? Now that would be my pleasure!

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: But I also have to help all these other guests sign in... Hmmm, what would Mizuki do?

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: I'm afraid I'll have to ask you to wait inside for a short while. I'll be with you as soon as possible!
